candidates.rationale: Paul describes Christ as holding all things together, emphasizing the sustaining power that keeps creation functioning.
God's Son sustains all things by his powerful word, explaining the ongoing maintenance of the entire universe.
Paul declares that in God we live and move and have our being, acknowledging the fundamental dependency of all existence on divine sustenance.
Nehemiah's prayer praises God for making and preserving the heavens, earth, and all their hosts, recognizing the wonder of continued existence.
The psalmist marvels at God's intricate providence in water cycles, vegetation, and ecosystems that reliably function to sustain life.
